items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: got a job with Zez Confrey

ctx.x: Well, I over to Paris -- Dave Tough, my good friend was over there and I went over to have a look at it and then found that the bands -- the music would be bad, so I came back and went right out to Chicago and got a job with Zez Confrey. That was kind of a funny thing because Zez was not a jazz pianist, but he was a good composer, he wrote all those, Kitten on the Keys.
I'll tell you who we haven't talked about, the Chicago musician. You mentioned him a moment ago. We never talked about that beautiful guy Muggsy Spanier.
